messages:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts across inference-gateway-prod. Alerting SRE rotation.

maria_sre: seeing spike in 502/504s from the gateway logs. 5xx rate ~14% across west region. Symptoms: long queue times at scheduler, many batches pending.

ben_oncall: paging in. grabbing context. Which routes are highest? customer-facing or internal?

maria_sre: high for /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions. Median latencies jumped from 120ms -> 2.4s and then 504s start at about 30s.

carol_runtime: adding: runtime metrics show scheduler backlog increase starting ~1931234000. Batching queues at 85% capacity, cpu on scheduler pods pegged. KV cache hits unchanged. Suspect continuous small requests are creating lots of tiny batches -> queue head-of-line behavior.

liya_prod: impacted customers reporting timeouts. Top ticket: "payments-bot" experiencing repeated timeouts causing user-facing failures. Flagging for CC.

ben_oncall: ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce batching window to 0 (disable auto-batching) on gateway route for non-SLAs, 2) enable fallback routing to small-model-lite for high-latency requests, 3) scale up scheduler replicas if autoscaler can react. Who can flip batching config?

carol_runtime: I can toggle batching. Doing quick test on canary gateway route now. Command I'll run: 
```bash
./ctl runtime set-config --route /v1/generate --auto-batching false --reason "incident: reduce HOL"
```

maria_sre: note: disabling batching will increase token cost but should reduce queue HOL blocking. Do we accept cost for emergency?

liya_prod: yes for now. prioritize availability. Let me notify customers that we're mitigating.

ben_oncall: carol, go ahead. also open a temporary rate-limit for anonymous traffic: 10rps per api-key. Can you add?

carol_runtime: applying both now. patch rolling out to gateway cluster 3/3.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for config-change runtime-config-20260315-1723 by carol_runtime. Status: in-progress.

maria_sre: I see backlog length dropping on scheduler after ~45s. 5xx rate falling to ~6%. Still some tail.

sam_network: network note: no upstream failures in LB layer. Healthchecks green. This looks internal to scheduler/batcher.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: ben_oncall acknowledged incident. Escalation level: P1.

ben_oncall: next step: route heavy customers to dedicated pool if possible. liya can you decide which customers to move?

liya_prod: I'm moving high priority customers (payments-bot, search-inc) to dedicated-darwin-1. Will kick their traffic using route override now.

carol_runtime: route override command: 
```bash
./ctl router set-weight --route payments-bot --cluster dedicated-darwin-1 --weight 1.0 --reason "incident reroute"
```
Applying...

maria_sre: good, metrics show customers on dedicated pool dropping errors to near zero. Overall 5xx now 2.2%. Gateway latencies still elevated for a small fraction.

ben_oncall: I'm going to scale scheduler replicas by +2 to relieve pressure while we investigate root cause. Triggering HPA override.

carol_runtime: scaling done. New pods joining, warming kv caches. Also rolling a kernel optimization hotfix for the scheduling loop - will take a few minutes to rollout.

maria_sre: important note: the initial spike looks correlated with a surge of many tiny gen requests from a single API key pattern (high QPS, tiny token length). That pattern defeats batching heuristics and causes many small batches to queue and block larger batches behind them.

ben_oncall: can we evict tiny requests policy: prioritize by estimated token length or age? Not now. For now we have two mitigations: reduced batching and routing heavy customers off. Also added short TTL eviction on queue (evict requests waiting > 10s).

carol_runtime: eviction toggle enabled: 
```json
{"queue_eviction_threshold_s":10}
```
Note: this will return a 503 for evicted requests. We should warn customers.

liya_prod: customer comms: posting incident notice to status page and DM'ing top 10 affected accounts. Draft: "We experienced elevated timeouts due to scheduler backlog. We've applied emergency mitigations (batching disabled for some routes, emergency reroutes to dedicated pools). We continue to monitor. No permanent data loss."

maria_sre: 5xx rate now steady ~1.1% and trending down. Queue occupancy normalized.

ben_oncall: handing off to night oncall @maria_sre in 10m. I'll update PD incident and include runbook steps, what we toggled, and outstanding follow-ups.

maria_sre: taking over. Summary for handoff: 1) batching disabled on /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions for non-SLA keys. 2) rate-limit for anonymous keys at 10rps. 3) route overrides for payments-bot & search-inc to dedicated-darwin-1. 4) eviction threshold set to 10s. 5) scheduler replicas +2, runtime hotfix rolling. Watch: gauge scheduler_queue_len, batch_fill_rate, gateway_5xx_rate.

ben_oncall: outstanding: need root cause analysis on why tiny-request storm happened and how to improve batching heuristics to avoid HOL blocking. Also add an automatic emergency fallback to light models when backlog > X. Create postmortem.

maria_sre: ack. I'll create postmortem ticket and assign to runtime/infra. linking ticket when created.

liya_prod: raising a follow-up: evaluate customer-facing throttling tiers so one noisy key can't degrade others.

carol_runtime: added a quick todo: improve batch prioritization by estimated tokens and age. Will prototype tomorrow.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: runtime-config-20260315-1723 rollout succeeded. kernel-hotfix rollouts at 70% healthy.

maria_sre: final check: gateway 5xx now <0.5% and user complaints reduced significantly. Keeping incident open for monitoring and postmortem.

ben_oncall: thanks team. handing off clean. :white_check_mark:

maria_sre: will take it from here and post the postmortem link when ready.

liya_prod: thanks all. I'll follow up on customer comms and refunds if needed.

carol_runtime: logging notes for postmortem: attach logs: 
- scheduler metrics around 1931233500-1931235200
- gateway logs for keys matching pattern id: /[a-z0-9]{8}-spike
- config-change diffs

maria_sre: incident closed for live mitigation, transitioning to RCA phase.
